description: A switch passing one of eight inputs to a single output, with the input chosen by a trigger on its own row

params.text: Selects that row by hand, and lights while that row is the selected one

inputs.text: A rising edge selects that row, so its input is the one passed to Out
The signal passed to Out while that row is the selected one

outputs.text: Carries the input of the selected row, with as many channels as that input has
